descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Equivalent Money Combinations (F1.1)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 2 unit on Canadian money equivalence framed around Tappy the Toonie Frog and Loonie Lou the Mouse. Children make amounts up to $200 in many ways using coins and bills.
long_description: Tappy the Toonie Frog and Loonie Lou the Mouse teach Canadian money equivalence! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 2 unit covers F1.1. Day 1 makes 50¢ in 3 ways. Day 2 makes $1 in 3 ways. Day 3 mixes BILLS and COINS for $35. Day 4 introduces the $100 bill and makes $150. Day 5 closes with a Big Tap-to-Pay Capstone — children find combos for $1, $25, $100, $150. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-2 trap: wrong-total, over-shoot, all-coins, impractical-combo, single-combo), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite, and Junior Money Master G2 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day money equivalence unit (F1.1).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on Canadian money exploration with character-driven tap-to-pay frame, structured pair work, and progression from coin combos to bill combos to amounts up to $200.
